# Example drawing set

All products and wire constructions are synthetic examples. The project is stamped NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION.

- Open `example.riser.json` in Project. Restore `example-library.json` in Libraries if your local seed IDs were changed.
- `example-riser.pdf` contains the riser and schedules on two ARCH D sheets.
- `example-riser-dxf.zip` contains one native DXF per sheet. `example-riser-tiled.dxf` places sheets at 2-inch gaps; the individual DXFs are also included.
- `engineering-results.json` records computed runs, checks, loading, DMX and BOM for inspection.

See `../docs/cad-import-test.md` for measured CAD behavior and `../docs/user-guide.md` for the application workflow. The PDF uses its project date, 2026-09-24, for deterministic metadata; verification was completed on 2026-09-25.
